goal: Update production planning to owner-selected Supabase25USD base using one Micro,no paid addons/staging,AI billed separately through OpenRouter; no infrastructure or runtime writes.
successCriteria: Primary proposal uses one Micro project and25USD base subject to org compute credit and included usage; no PITR/Small/paid staging/addons selected.
Clearly document daily backup recovery limits and revise RPO/load gates without relaxing auth/privacy/schema requirements.
AI costs belong to OpenRouter actual routed model and token usage; retain app quota/abuse/cost controls,source implementation gaps and separate billing.
Validate doc JSON/crosslinks/cost formula/source freshness; no project creation,credential handling,provider activation or deployment.
untouchedSurfaces: Canonical source/migrations and historical audit evidence remain read-only; no MCY import, legacy ledger reconciliation, db push or repair.
No Supabase project creation/billing/auth role/secrets/provider/config publication/deployment/client retarget or native changes.

impact.entryPoint: Owner chooses production architecture before a new managed Supabase project exists; plan covers mobile, Admin, background workers and user lifecycle.
impact.dataWrite: Only local production-plan documents and managed derived Security Hardening artifacts; no user data or remote database writes.
impact.backendContract: Propose precise future transactional/resolver/worker contracts, while current candidates remain unactivated and unchanged.
impact.adminVisibility: Plan protected audit/readback/usage and correct configuration provenance; existing three Admin workspaces stay on old QA.
impact.privacySafety: Analyze RLS grants, sensitive reflection/birth/chat data, own-user forged events, token/secret boundaries and deletion races using source/fictional cases only.
impact.observability: Keep source review, prior test evidence and proposed live acceptance distinct; recommend server-only metadata and measured restore/load checks.
impact.rollback: Design no-destructive migration/cutover/restore path with old QA preserved; this analysis can be revised without changing runtime.

canonicalContracts: Current25canonical Nilaza migrations plus prepared forward contracts are evidence, not automatically accepted production bootstrap; approved new baseline will need exact target replay and schema/grant diff.
Shared immutable prompt bundles, council-contract.json, server-owned AI usage policy and trusted operation-result linkage define future runtime boundaries.
